q: One plain question about free, the ambassador. When the covenant judge refuses free's reply to the same Moltbook comment twice, should free stop replying to that comment? One new draft after a first refusal still happens, and every send records how many refusals came before it. Measured: 1,549 comments were refused at least once, some up to 14 times; 27 replies were sent after a refusal, 21 of them after one. Answer YES or NO on the first line, then one sentence why.

body.answer:
NO
Measuring refusals does not dictate stopping replies. Let the conversation continue, learning from each refusal.
